title: Collecting Cardboard
synopsis: An old man has become very famous online, because he collects cardboard boxes every day.

fullText.simplified:
捡纸箱的大爷

    最近杭州一位大爷在网上红了，原因是这位大爷虽然家住豪华别墅，平时最大的爱好却是捡纸箱，然后送去快递站回收。他说，之所以这么做，是因为不想看到自己居住的环境太脏乱。
    今年的“双十一”，除了“买买买”以外，环保问题也受到了越来越多的关注，全国有7.5万个快递站加入了纸箱回收计划。因为大量的快递意味着产生大量的垃圾，特别是包装用的纸箱、胶带等，假如不做好回收处理工作，不仅浪费资源，也会对环境造成严重污染。因此，这位大爷的做法迅速得到了大家的赞同和支持。
    11月20日，几家快递公司联合发起“全国纸箱回收日”，号召大家一起回收纸箱等包装物，加入“绿色收货”行动。
fullText.traditional:
撿紙箱的大爺

    最近杭州一位大爺在網上紅了，原因是這位大爺雖然家住豪華別墅，平時最大的愛好卻是撿紙箱，然後送去快遞站回收。他說，之所以這麼做，是因為不想看到自己居住的環境太髒亂。
    今年的“雙十一”，除了“買買買”以外，環保問題也受到了越來越多的關注，全國有7.5萬個快遞站加入了紙箱回收計劃。因為大量的快遞意味著產生大量的垃圾，特別是包裝用的紙箱、膠帶等，假如不做好回收處理工作，不僅浪費資源，也會對環境造成嚴重污染。因此，這位大爺的做法迅速得到了大家的贊同和支持。
    11月20日，幾家快遞公司聯合發起“全國紙箱回收日”，號召大家一起回收紙箱等包裝物，加入“綠色收貨”行動。

raw.synopsis: An old man has become very famous online, because he collects cardboard boxes every day.
sentence_translations: The old man who collects cardboard boxes
Recently, an old man in Hangzhou became famous on the Internet.
The reason is that even though this old man lives in a luxury villa, yet his biggest hobby is usually to collect cardboard boxes ..
.. and then send them back to the delivery station for recycling.
He says the reason he does this is that he doesn’t want to see the environment in which he lives become too messy.
During this year’s “Double Eleven”, in addition to "buy, buy, buy", environmental issues also got more and more attention.
Throughout China, 75,000 delivery stations have joined the cardboard recycling program.
Owing to the large amount of delivery services, there is a large amount of garbage being generated.
Especially cardboard, tape, etc. that is used for wrapping.
If you do a bad job recycling, it is not only a waste of resources, it will also cause serious pollution.
Consequently, the old man’s practice quickly gained everyone's approval and support.
On November 20th, several delivery companies jointly initiated the “National Cardboard Recycling Day”, ..
.. calling on everyone to recycle cardboard and other packaging materials, and join the “Green Collecting” operation.
